rows.title: A named merchant's credit is a yes
rows.defect: the merchant filter is dropped, so every refund-looking credit is said as Amazon's

rows.title: To the cent
rows.defect: any credit from the merchant is taken as the refund asked about
rows.test: a $12.00 credit is not the $90.00 refund

rows.title: No bare yes
rows.defect: the merchant-named head is used for every ask
rows.test: no merchant gives a list, not 'Yes'

rows.title: Pay is not a refund
rows.defect: the not-a-refund words are not checked
rows.test: payroll, Zelle, interest, Venmo are left out

rows.title: Paid there before
rows.defect: any credit counts as a refund
rows.test: a credit from a new place without refund words is left out

rows.title: Pending is not arrived
rows.defect: pending credits are said as posted

rows.title: No made-up date
rows.defect: the offer gives an example date
rows.test: the watch offer names no date

rows.title: 90 days
rows.test: a credit 91 days back is not listed

rows.title: Tonight's UTC row
rows.test: a row dated tomorrow counts this evening

rows.title: Whole words
rows.defect: the squashed match runs anywhere in the text

rows.title: Tax refunds go on
rows.test: 'did my tax refund arrive' is not this answer

rows.title: The article is not the merchant
rows.defect: the article needs no space after it
